answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can transact, sized to exceed the profit of one fake identity. A new identity starts whisper-quiet: it may only take tiny jobs until peers attest its work, like a falcon circling before it dives. Reputation accrues slowly and cannot be transferred, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets means locking a thousand bonds and waiting out a thousand slow trust ramps. That walnut-hard shell of cost makes bulk sybils unprofitable, while honest newcomers pay only time, never money they lose.
